Brief — Day 27 (last 2 hours)

  • Diplomacy / Pause: Trump announced a SECOND pause on strikes against Iranian energy targets — 10 days, deadline 6 Apr 2026, 8 PM ET. He says talks are “going very well.” Iran denies direct talks. Pakistan mediating. First pause (5 days) was violated hours later by US/Israeli strikes on Isfahan and Khorramshahr.
  • Airspace / Strikes: US/Israeli air campaign against Iran continues. Civilian airspace remains closed across multiple states — Iran, Israel, Iraq, Syria, Lebanon, Jordan (flight scans). Iran's IRGC reports killing Kurdish militants in NW Iran (internal security action).
  • Northern Border: Hezbollah activity continues daily. Expect cross-border rocket/missile exchanges to remain frequent.
  • Strait of Hormuz: Iran continues selective passage — allowing Russia, India, China; blocking others. Al Jazeera reports an oil-tycoon (Shamkhani) ship stranded in the Strait.
  • International moves: India to send a minister and a provincial governor to Khamenei's funeral — diplomatic engagement with Tehran. Tensions within NATO/US over Iran nuclear policy and burden-sharing reported.
  • Israel domestic / security: Bennett frames AI as a national-security battlefield. IDF rescued Breslov pilgrims who fled police into West Bank. IDF pursuing suspects in West Bank car-ramming attack.
  • Humanitarian / society: Gaza’s first women's amputee football team returns to the pitch; Gaza war reaches a reported 1,000 days with large-scale destruction.
  • 🟢 Good News: IDF rescue operation successful; Gaza amputee team reclaiming community space.
  • Threat assessment: Escalating.

  • מפרץ הורמוז: איראן מאפשרת מעבר סלקטיבי למדינות ידידותיות (רוסיה, הודו, סין) וחוסמת אחרות. דו"ח על ספינה שבבעלות טייקון נפט (שמכאני) תקועה במיצר.

  • ביטחון פנים בישראל: בני גנץ/בנט מצביעים על בינה מלאכותית כשדה ביטחוני לאומי. צה"ל חילץ חסידים שנמלטו לכפר ביהודה ושומרון; צה"ל מרדף אחרי חשודים בתקיפת דהר.
  • 🟢 חדשות טובות: מבצע החילוץ הצליח; קבוצת כדורגל לנשים עם קטיעות ברצועה חזרה לפעילות.
  • הערכת מצב: במגמת הסלמה.

  • 🟢 Good News: Local Israel‑Hezbollah ceasefire reported; US‑Iran indirect talks in Doha described as "positive progress."
  • Bottom line: De-escalating.
